card.architecture: MiniMax-H3 fl2va (Qwen3-VL 32B, int8 ConvRot) — TEXT-TO-VIDEO with native audio
card.summary: Text→video with NATIVE stereo audio — voice, sound effects and music are generated in the same pass as the picture, not layered on after. Distilled sampling (no CFG/negative); the output is an mp4 with a baked-in audio track.
card.pick_when: You want a short video whose audio (voice/SFX/music) is generated together with the picture from one prompt.

prompt.guidance: Describe the scene AND the motion AND the audio; H3 renders sound from the prompt too.
prompt.example: a neon night market in the rain, slow dolly forward, reflections on wet stone. Audio: gentle rain, distant chatter, a soft synth score.
prompt.overview: Describe the whole scene from scratch — subject, motion, camera, lighting, style — and add an explicit Audio line: H3 models voice, sound effects and music jointly with the video, so the prompt directs the soundtrack as well as the picture.
prompt.instructions: Write a shot the way you would for any text→video model (subject, motion, camera move, lighting, style, atmosphere), sequencing actions in temporal order. Then add an 'Audio:' section describing the sound you want — ambience, specific effects timed to the action, dialogue, and score. Wrap any spoken lines or on-screen text in quotation marks. Timeline cues in the form [0s-2s]/[2s-4s] help H3 place events and audio beats.
do: Describe subject, motion, camera, lighting and style like a normal t2v prompt
Add an explicit 'Audio:' line: ambience, timed sound effects, dialogue, and score
Sequence actions temporally; timeline cues like [0s-2s] help place beats
Quote spoken lines and on-screen text
Use concrete camera-move terms (dolly, pan, tilt, orbit, push-in, static)
dont: Don't rely on negative prompts — this is a distilled model (no CFG/negative)
Don't omit the subject/scene (t2v invents everything from text)
Don't forget the audio: leaving it out wastes H3's main capability
examples: A lone figure sprints across rain-slicked rooftops at dusk, leaping a gap between towers as pursuers close in. Anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, restrained color grade, powerful natural movement. Audio: wind and rapid footsteps, a low score underneath, an accent hit on each leap.
prompt.negative_guidance: Negatives are not used — H3 samples distilled through a BasicGuider (no CFG).

speed.measured_note: large video model with a 32B text encoder; not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Makes a short video WITH sound from text. Describe the scene, the motion, and the audio.
